method: Complete four pinned source reads, Git/SHA256 verification; original AST Sphinx finder executed with fake inventory.
findings: Sphinx fallback parses numeric suffix as float, so8.10 becomes8.1 and sorts below8.9. Original function selects8.9 from a fake inventory containing both; no actual compiler/builder invoked.
Fallback glob does not explicitly check executability or enforce required Sphinx version; unversioned which result wins immediately.

Feature probes mix SCons.Conftest checks, whose error-string return conventions differ from context.TryCompile boolean, and explicitly invert former results. No inversion bug claimed from unfamiliar return conventions.

FIEMAP probes type availability, xattr probes header/functions, CRC probes declaration and CPU builtin compile support. These do not establish filesystem support, CPU instruction safety or live ioctl behavior.

Target architecture/OS is detected from compiler macros rather than Python host, useful for cross builds; /sys/block check instead examines build-host filesystem. Cross-target runtime qualification remains separate.
C23 embed probe temporarily replaces CCFLAGS and restores after TryCompile, without a finally block if probe raises. No exceptional SCons run executed.
Payload encoder rejects comment terminator, emits exact byte literals plus decoded comments. Generated configuration depends on source substitution; no build/install was performed.
NUM_CPU is converted directly to int with no positive bound; invalid/zero/negative configuration needs caller validation. No worker-count failure claimed without SConstruct review.

Version parsing requires accepted SemVer subset and codename; prerelease maps explicitly to PEP440. Revision uses repository-root check then archive metadata, neither proves dirty state or reproducible binary identity.
CLI install references staged prefix; uninstall target references prefix. DESTDIR uninstall semantics require full parent-build evaluation; no removal executed.

executed_control.scope: Original function with fake PATH inventory and absent unversioned binary; no executable invoked.

limits: No full configure/build, install, cross-platform runtime or performance qualification.
